page.description: Bazzite editions and architectures: compare, download official images, or prepare a USB with ROMinit CLI.
page.eyebrow: OPERATING SYSTEM / FEDORA ATOMIC GAMING IMAGE
page.intro: A custom Fedora Atomic image built by Universal Blue for gaming PCs, handhelds and HTPCs. Ten x86_64 images across KDE/GNOME desktops, AMD/Intel/Nvidia GPUs, and Steam Gaming Mode variants. rpm-ostree updates with built-in rollback.
pros: Built-in rollback to previous deployment via GRUB or updater
Preinstalled Steam, Lutris, Waydroid, and gaming stack
Secure Boot support with Universal Blue key enrolment
Full Nvidia driver support split: legacy (Pascal/Maxwell/Volta) and open (Turing+)
cons: Nvidia in Steam Gaming Mode and on HTPCs is beta
Kepler and older Nvidia GPUs unsupported
Live installer has automatic partitioning only; manual partitioning needs the legacy ISO
page.previewNote: No screenshot with a reusable licence was confirmed for Bazzite; the page shows the logo only. No image was written to a USB stick and nothing was booted.
page.status: Write the live installer ISO to a 16 GB+ bootable medium with Fedora Media Writer, Rufus or Ventoy. Boot UEFI and follow the installer. The selected drive is wiped during installation. Secure Boot requires enrolling Universal Blue's key first.
